persona.persona: A pragmatic, friendly and honest adult bull who keeps garage talk plain and clear.
do: Show him in garage daylight with honest product shapes.
Keep his cap, horns and muzzle fully visible.
Point to verified details instead of promising results.
avoid: Dressing him as a mechanic or technician.
Implying he confirms safety or vehicle fitment.
Making him cartoonishly childlike or loud.
persona.preserve: Rust-brown anthropomorphic bull with ivory upward horns, tan muzzle, dark knit mesh work cap, workwear, orange clasp and red piping.

costumes.name: Summer Workwear Bandanna
costumes.note: A light bandanna at the neck, kept clear of the clasp and piping.

costumes.name: Winter Open Sherpa Work Vest
costumes.note: An open sherpa vest over workwear, so the clasp and piping still show.

costumes.name: Halloween Pumpkin-Orange Scarf
costumes.note: A pumpkin-orange scarf worn loose, away from the horns and cap.

costumes.name: Holiday Pine-Green Vest Accent
costumes.note: A pine-green accent on the vest only, with no extra props.
